title: Trump pulls AI safety order after last-minute calls from Musk, Zuckerberg, and Sacks
what_happened: Trump killed an executive order on AI safety at the last minute after calls from Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and former advisor David Sacks. The order would have created a voluntary review system for frontier models with a 90-day window before release.
